title: Notifications inbox with detail pane
describe: an inbox with a list and a detail pane
prompt:
Build a notifications inbox at /.

Requirements:
- A heading "Inbox" and a list of five messages, hard-coded and all unread at first: "Welcome aboard", "Quarterly report ready", "Password changed", "New comment on Roadmap" and "Invoice paid". Each message is a button named by its title.
- A line "<n> unread" counting unread messages ("5 unread" at first).
- Choosing a message opens its detail beside or below the list: its title as a heading and a body. The body of "Quarterly report ready" is "The report for Q3 is attached". Opening a message marks it read.
- A button "Mark all as read" that makes the count "0 unread".
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.

steps.text: The report for Q3 is attached
